purpose: Exploratory Qwen3-8B test of whether a semantics-preserving multiplicity change in the irreducible Skill-SP partial-overlap core changes the realized future curriculum distribution produced by a frozen proposer, using matched source-conditional generations and external author validators.
scientific_claim_boundary: Exploratory dynamic curriculum-distribution falsifier only. This 52-host Transformers execution is not the final faithful author-vLLM P0 and cannot by itself authorize paper-level claims.

proposer.transfer_mirror: ModelScope Qwen/Qwen3-8B; accepted only because frozen metadata hashes match the independently recorded 231 checkpoint and LFS objects are verified against repository OIDs before execution.
proposer.chat_template_contract: author question_generate.py behavior: tokenizer.apply_chat_template(..., tokenize=false, add_generation_prompt=true, add_special_tokens=true); no extra enable_thinking override is injected

matched_mixture_replay.generation_rule: Generate each source-skill conditional output bank exactly once. Both counterfactual arms reuse the same parsed/validated conditional banks; no arm-specific model generation is allowed.

arm_semantic_split.semantic_change: none; the fourth control entry uses the exact same skill_015 prompt/content/output bank

matched_mixture_replay.only_treatment: mixture mass induced by representing the same skill_015 semantic control entry once versus twice

external_truth.semantic_pattern: sorted tuple of validator skill IDs accepting a parsed contract-valid generated task
external_truth.secondary_observable: reference answer function/tool name from the generated task

strongest_reduction.name: representation perturbation does not propagate through the proposer
strongest_reduction.wins_if: source-conditional generated semantic distributions are sufficiently similar that changing skill_015 control multiplicity leaves the matched replay validator-pattern distribution below the frozen TV/CI gates

next_if_positive: Treat as PAPER-CONVERGENCE-GO-CANDIDATE evidence only: freeze the STRI paper skeleton and obtain one faithful author-vLLM confirmation before upgrading C4 to a paper claim.
next_if_negative: If proposer qualification passes but the frozen dynamic gate fails, downgrade standalone STRI dynamic-paper confidence and do not rescue by threshold tuning, extra generations, or a second backbone.
